newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank sets tender for 14-day repos at 3.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank sets tender for 14-day repos at 3.0 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Tuesday it was setting a tender for 14-day securities repurchase funds, offering banks liquidity at a fixed rate of 3.00 percent.
A 72.9 billion mark repo pact expires on Wednesday. The repo rate has been at 3.00 percent since late August.
Funds will be credited to accounts tomorrow and the securities have to be repurchased on March 19, the Bundesbank said in a statement. --Frankfurt Newsroom + 49 75 65 1209
